Continuation Loser Detector

Findings (default settings, Alpaca SIP bars Jul 2025 – Nov 2026; tune = Jul 25–Jun 26, holdout = Q3 26):
  1. The replay does not show the strategy Chris describes. At 5%, $50+, cover 20 min, 5 bps: tune 368 trades, 48.1% win, PF 0.91, −8.2 bps avg; holdout Q3-26 136 trades, 43.4% win, PF 0.75; Oct–Nov-26 71 trades, PF 0.86. Winners average +164 bps (median +125), not +30; losers average −169. Losses are spread out, not a 1–2-a-day tail: 119 of 368 tune trades are continuation losers (≤ −150 bps, or a new high after entry and ≤ −75 bps). PyBroker reproduces the holdout replay exactly (136/136 trades, same entry minute, 1.75 bps mean difference).
  2. Nothing known at entry separates losers. The best single entry feature has AUC 0.57 (distance from entry to high of day; others ≤ 0.57). A depth-3 tree reaches 51% precision / 62% recall in-sample but 33% / 37% on the holdout, and every holdout permutation importance is ≤ 0. The best tune skip rule (entry_vs_hod_bps > 134: PF 0.91 → 1.22) falls to PF 0.73 on the holdout.
  3. The first minutes do carry signal, but bailing doesn't pay. Return at minute 5 has AUC 0.19 (0.81 inverted) and MAE at minute 3 has 0.73. A minute-3 bail at −75 bps avoids 53 of 119 tune losers but costs 13 winners and the spread back to entry: PF 0.98 tune, 0.79 holdout. Small early losses keep mean-reverting often enough that cutting them costs as much as the tail.
  4. No rule tested reaches 60% win / PF ≥ 1.5 on any period. Before more filter mining, reconcile the replay with Chris's own trade list. The gap between +30 bps winners and the +164 bps / 48% win replay suggests a different entry (protected limit, 30-second bars, or another arm rule). Use the controls to try 4%, other holds or labels.
    1. backtest-expert stress test (section 8): REJECT / Abandon. Across 4%/5% × 10–30 min holds × 5–10 bps slippage (90 cells), none reaches 60% win / PF ≥ 1.5. No (trigger, hold) pair is profitable in every period: PF stays 0.78–0.98 on the tune year for all ten. Only 5 of 17 months were positive. The only PF ≥ 1.5 cells are 4% with a 10–15 min hold in Oct–Nov 2026 alone (PF 1.58–1.59, 55–57% win), the same settings ran PF 0.84–0.86 in the tune year, so that is one regime, not an edge. The skill's gate returns REJECT for the baseline and the best bail rule (negative expectancy; also only ~1.4 years of SIP history, under its 5-year minimum).
Setup replayed: US stocks ||(\ge||) $50, ATR14 ||(\ge||) 3%, 20-day ADDV ||(\ge||) $100M (tiers $100M–$1B and >$1B), open 0.25–1.0 ATR above prior close, high reaches open × (1 + 4 or 5%) before 10:00 ET (8:00 MT). The first red 1-minute bar arms; the short fills at the next bar's open; cover 20 minutes later; 5 bps slippage. Every feature below uses only bars before the fill (plus daily history before the day). Thresholds and rules are chosen on the tune year only; the holdout and forward periods are scored, never fitted.
